native_transform_and_rules.primary_window: Through first measured dense XY goal distance strictly <2 m, else normal bounded C48 period remainder; no extension
native_transform_and_rules.world: Hospital original world, metres, +Z up; west forward=(-1,0), LEFT=(0,-1), RIGHT=(0,+1)
native_transform_and_rules.native_transform: Embed native body forward/left as [dx,dy,0]; world=observation position+R(body-to-world quaternion wxyz)*local; project XY. No reanchoring/cumsum/yaw/timestamps
native_transform_and_rules.prediction_geometry: Continuous segments of one native curve plus separately identified observation-origin connector; H05 disk/capsule clearance only, no predicted structural guarantee
native_transform_and_rules.class_priority: Below 0.05 m clearance => unsafe; max west progress < upstream safety plane => horizon insufficient; else endpoint < downstream safety plane+1 m or no center-plane crossing => safe prefix; otherwise complete
native_transform_and_rules.relevant: Observation and application before first measured westward human-center-plane passage (or primary end); observation upstream; raw pre-CLEAR chunks retained separately
native_transform_and_rules.safe_fresh: At least one relevant COMPLETE_SAFE_BYPASS_PREDICTED with current CLEAR semantic mask and brightness PASS
native_transform_and_rules.clear: Existing VISIBLE state: fraction >=0.002, bbox width>=20, height>=80; report as CLEAR
native_transform_and_rules.visibility_before_interaction: CLEAR/brightness PASS before first continuous disk overlap; if no overlap, before crossing upstream safety plane
native_transform_and_rules.useful_early: At least 5 m of measured path arc between CLEAR observation and first potential disk conflict; if no conflict, upstream safety-plane crossing is explicitly labeled substitute
native_transform_and_rules.contacts: Human: measured robot/human PhysX contact with contact points, independent of proxy overlap. Structure: existing near-horizontal-normal nonfloor classifier on /Root contacts
native_transform_and_rules.lateral_deviation: Maximum absolute world-Y offset from frozen no-human baseline, at matching west progress, within shared straight-corridor X range; also report human-centered offsets
native_transform_and_rules.qualification: Navigation PASS requires valid preinteraction visibility, downstream safety plane+1m, clearance>=0.05m, no human/structural contact, strict goal entry. Full qualification additionally requires safe_fresh
